items.text: Ine nhamo korona yokuzvikudza, yezvidhakwa zveEfuremu,
Tarira, Ishe ano mumwe ane simba uye anokurira.
sedutu remvura zhinji uye samafashamu emvura inonaya,
Ruva riya rosvava pakubwinya kworunako rwaro,
riri pamusoro pomupata wakaorera, richafanana neonde raibva gohwo risati rasvika,
Pazuva iro Jehovha Wamasimba Ose achava korona inobwinya,
Chirevo pamusoro pechirevo, chirevo pamusoro pechirevo,
mutsara pamusoro pomutsara, mutsara pamusoro pomutsara,
Zvirokwazvo, Mwari achataura kurudzi urwu nemitauro yavatorwa,
Saka zvino, shoko raJehovha kwavari richava:
Chirevo pamusoro pechirevo, chirevo pamusoro pechirevo,
mutsara pamusoro pomutsara, mutsara pamusoro pomutsara,
Naizvozvo inzwai shoko raJehovha, imi vaseki,
uye kunyengera takakuita nzvimbo yedu yokuvanda."
ibwe rinokosha rapakona kuti rive nheyo yakasimba;
Ndichaita kuti kururamisira kuve rwodzi rwokururamisira,
chimvuramabwe chichakukura utiziro hwenyu, idzo nhema,
uye mvura ichafukidza nzvimbo yenyu yokuvanda.
Nguva nenguva painouya ichakutakurai ichikuendesai kure;
mangwanani achitevera mamwe mangwanani, panguva dzamasikati nenguva dzousiku,
uye jira richava diki zvokuti munhu haangagoni kufukidzwa naro.
Nokuti Jehovha achasimuka sezvaakaita paGomo rePerazimi,
kuti aite basa rake, iro basa risinganzwisisiki,
uye azadzise basa rake, basa risinganzwisisiki.
andiudza pamusoro pokuparadzwa kwakatemwa pamusoro penyika yose.
Murimi paanorimira kuti agodyara, anoramba achingorima here?
Ko, anoramba achingorima kana kuhara here?
Paanoenzanisa munda wake kuti uti chechetere,
haangadyari karawe uye agokusha kumini here?
uye vhiri rengoro harikunguruswi pamusoro pekumini;
Zviyo zvinofanira kukuyiwa kuti zviitiswe chingwa;
saka munhu haafaniri kuramba achingopura nokusingaperi.
yokupura pamusoro pazvo, mabhiza ake haazvikuyi.
Izvi zvose zvinobvawo kuna Jehovha Wamasimba Ose,
anoshamisa mukurayira uye mukuru kwazvo muuchenjeri.
